messages:
Marta Ruiz: Quick sync: dense Console form — finalizing validation surface. Options: compact inline errors that don't reflow, or top-level toast summary with anchor links to fields. Thoughts?
Devin Chen: Inline = clear mapping, but in dense rows it causes layout jumps. Lean toast summary + inline terse markers.
Ellie Wong: a11y concern: when fields are inside collapsed accordions SRs may not find inline errors. If we use inline markers, add aria-invalid and aria-describedby regardless of visible helper.
Noah Rivera: also ensure focus moves to first invalid field on submit and open containing section. Toast links can also focus the field.
Marta Ruiz: copy for required: do we keep asterisk + legend or explicit small "Required" postfix? Asterisk is compact but ambiguous.
Devin Chen: prefer small explicit "Required" for first item in a group and legend for remaining — prevents over-decoration.
Ellie Wong: if we keep asterisk, make it programmatically exposed (aria-label) and ensure contrast meets WCAG on dim theme. Also add data-required="true" for automation.
Noah Rivera: destructive confirmations: typed-confirm for irreversible DB/metrics deletes; modal+undo for single-item UI deletes. Typed token should be lowercase single word, no punctuation.
Marta Ruiz: example: \"Type delete-pool to permanently remove this pool. This cannot be undone.\"
Devin Chen: toast collision: autosave info toasts vs validation toasts — we should only allow one visible toast ranked by priority (error > undo > info). Queue others.
Ellie Wong: small CSS note: focus outline for compact inputs must be >=3px and visible under dim theme.
design-bot: Filed: https://go.redwood/design/issues/CI-451 "Dense form validation flavors + a11y checklist". Assigned to @Marta.
Marta Ruiz: Action items: mock 2 variants — (A) toast summary with anchor links + inline compact markers + ARIA; (B) persistent tiny "Required" postfix + inline full helpers. Include SR announcement tests and keyboard-only test cases. Will post mocks by EOD tomorrow.
